authority_note: Named Siren Protocol models below select and reskin current Trigger Discipline reference-equipment behavior for the v0.1 authored profile. They are not immutable setting-wide balance canon and may be retuned without retconning the fiction.

ruleset_provenance.reference_values_status: test/tuning inputs upstream; explicitly selected here as Siren Protocol v0.1 implementation defaults

firearms.name: PALISADE K30 PDW
firearms.implementation_note: FULL AUTO exists physically; BURST/FULL AUTO resolve through the contained TD package when its actual weapon and ammunition prerequisites hold.

firearms.name: PALISADE R55 Service Rifle
firearms.implementation_note: BURST/FULL AUTO exist physically; BURST/FULL AUTO resolve through the contained TD package when its actual weapon and ammunition prerequisites hold.

firearms.name: PALISADE L65 Support Weapon
firearms.implementation_note: Use the contained TD firing operations only with a supported complete weapon, feed and ammunition profile. This reference entry does not supply a complete starting weapon state.

firearms.name: PALISADE B12 Entry Shotgun
firearms.implementation_note: Physical shell/chamber/cycle state remains authoritative. Use the contained TD supported loading/cycling operations and explicitly adjudicate any unsupported handling.

protection.name: PALISADE Civicweave Concealable Armour
protection.note: Civilian/executive cut. Personal RES only; does not create COVER.

protection.name: PALISADE FlexPlate Tactical Armour
protection.note: Tactical cut of the same v0.1 reference protection family; does not create COVER.

protection.name: PALISADE Wall-4 Ballistic Shield
protection.note: Directional physical COVER; occupies hands and can be flanked, destroyed, or penetrated.

protection.name: PALISADE Aegis Projected Screen
protection.note: A projected directional barrier exists in Siren Protocol. v0.1 does not invent universal barrier HP/material-resistance numbers or personal all-around shield HP.

effects.name: PALISADE Flash-4 Concussion Grenade
effects.duration: through the end of the affected target's next TEAM TURN when geometry leaves the target exposed

effects.name: PALISADE Fog-8 Smoke Grenade
effects.visual_rule: >=4m dense smoke blocks visual LOS; shorter dense traces add +3 DIFFICULTY to sight-dependent targeting/observation; other sensors use actual capability

medical.name: CALYX Field Medical Kit
does_not_support: baseline RESUSCITATION after vital failure without additional equipment

technical.name: ASTER Kite FPV Drone
technical.sensors: ordinary visual camera; clear-condition reference ~60m CONFIRMED / ~150m APPROXIMATE when resolvable

technical.name: EMBERLINE Oriel Autonomous Drone
technical.sensors: visual + low-light/thermal; clear-condition reference ~80m CONFIRMED / ~250m APPROXIMATE when resolvable
technical.note: No free attack routine. Armed behavior requires a separately defined real module and compatible Trigger Discipline rules.

technical.name: EMBERLINE Mesh Relay / Field Sensor Node
PALISADE Breach Kit
technical.note: Physical entry tools and consumables. Ownership grants no generic bonus; BREAKER/ENGINEERING rules and the actual barrier determine performance.

technical.name: Infiltration Tool Kit
technical.note: Lock/access tools, compact camera, line, cutters, and ordinary physical aids. It supplies real capabilities rather than a generic STEALTH bonus.

technical.name: Portable Intrusion Rig
technical.note: Cables, local interfaces, radios, compute, and protocol tools that can provide plausible access routes. It never invents a LINK, credential, privilege, or remote function that does not exist.

cybernetics.name: LATTICE CivicLink
cybernetics.mechanical_boundary: No automatic HACKING, INFLUENCE, access, or CHECK bonus. It is an interface to real systems the user is permitted or able to reach.

cybernetics.name: PALISADE TacLink
cybernetics.mechanical_boundary: Does not AIM for the wearer, erase RECOIL/COVER, or grant extra AP.

cybernetics.name: MORROW Multispectrum Optics
cybernetics.capability: low-light, thermal, rangefinding, and visual sensor modes
cybernetics.mechanical_boundary: Changes what can physically be sensed; does not automatically negate RANGE, COVER, AIM requirements, or uncertainty outside sensor capability.

cybernetics.name: MORROW Medical Telemetry Suite
cybernetics.mechanical_boundary: Does not automatically reveal hidden pathology or make treatment succeed.

cybernetics.name: VECTORLINE DriveLink
cybernetics.capability: direct control interface for compatible vehicles
cybernetics.mechanical_boundary: Provides a real control route; no generic VEHICLES bonus or extra action economy is implied.

cybernetics.name: EMBERLINE CommandMesh
cybernetics.capability: drone standing-order, command, and sensor-fusion interface
cybernetics.mechanical_boundary: Does not create free drone actions, weapons, sensors, links, or autonomy beyond actual equipment and TECH rules.

cybernetics.name: IRONLACE Reinforced Prosthetic Limb
cybernetics.mechanical_boundary: Does not automatically increase FORCE, CQC damage, movement, carry capacity, or AP. Any such advantage requires an explicit later mechanic.

ammunition_policy.note: Trigger Discipline permits Campaign Settings to define ammunition that changes target and/or material penetration. Siren Protocol v0.1 deliberately does not add a special-ammunition tuning catalog yet.
